name: prepare-plugin-submission
description: Guide OpenAI plugin preparation with a persistent submission wizard, source-bound checks, repairs and evidence.

interface.longDescription: Work through OpenAI plugin preparation as a guided conversation. Submission Studio tracks the current step, validates target-bound evidence, helps repair source and portal findings, prepares the ZIP and review materials, and guides the human through upload, review and publication. Save, resume or move a session without repeating completed inputs. Supports approved desktop stdio routes, modern MCP v2 test kits, ChatGPT/Codex report ingestion and applicability-aware audits. Blank unloaded templates are expected. Human portal observations, synthetic tests and verified local checks remain distinct.
